fact: The Supreme Council of Digital Society set ten controls for government contracts with cloud providers, including keeping national-security, secret and top-secret data in Egypt, data portability, and contract terms for data recovery and encryption-key control.
title: 10 ضوابط لتعاقد الجهات الحكومية مع مقدمى الخدمات السحابية أبرزها توطين البيانات السرية
